note: One agent's calls (not the maintainer's), made by reading headlines and, for the read twins only, saved text. Every unread article the headline screen marked as a career kind belongs to exactly one group. `call` is event (the headline announces a fact of one of G1's kinds), borderline (talk, rumour, a denial, a retrospective, or an unnamed opponent) or not_event (the screen's false positives). `match` is how sure the twin is the same fact: high (the same fact, named alike) or medium (the unread headline does not name the opponent or the date, so the match rests on timing and the story). Reasons and headlines are in data/unread-news.md (git-ignored).
